scope: All twelve cases and all decisions/samples. Sources, tensors, logs, binaries and graph CSVs are unbundled and represented by original receipts.

frozen_profile.training_weighting: Equal fixture weights, squared relative error to pooled control; 29 unique schedules. Baseline target median of all 14 control samples; chronological drift separately retained.
frozen_profile.training_holdout_description: Leave one full fixture out; train-only capacity selection. Wide12 not read or used.
frozen_profile.training_facts_origin: source-bound posthoc frontend replay, not recorded during original timing

numerical_validation_scope: Upstream CPU summary reread complete logical outputs against original FP64 references/bounds; guard/readonly checks are original Runtime reports, not a second guard-allocation read.
graph_observation_scope: Production graph protocol and full-output evidence; private per-node Driver observation is TIRx-only

Functional Torch output allocation is a separate contract.
